usage: The word '圖畫' (tou4 waa2) is a noun that refers to a picture or a drawing.
It can be used to describe an image hung on a wall or any artistic representation.
'圖畫' can be used in both formal and informal settings when talking about visual art.
This noun can appear with classifiers like '幅' to count pictures.
It often pairs with verbs like '睇' (to look) or '畫' (to draw) when used in sentences.
